collectionMethod: Manual capture of the official OpenCode Go docs page and landing page (English) around 10:30 Beijing time / 02:30Z on 2026-10-31, compared against the 2026-10-30 capture of the same pages. The per-model price tables (Go / Go Plus / Go Teams), the per-model Monthly limit column, the official 'Estimated requests' tables and the landing-page limits table were read as published. The change was additionally cross-checked against the official @opencode X post of 2026-10-30. Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed, no script changed.
scope: OpenCode Go official price and plan pages only, plus the official @opencode X announcement. On 2026-10-31 the per-model Monthly limit of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (both the Off-Peak and the Peak row) was raised in all three published plan tables — Go $80→$100, Go Plus $160→$200, Go Teams $85→$105 — with the three-part token prices unchanged, and the official 'Estimated requests' rows raised accordingly. The plan prices (Go $10/month, Go Plus $40/month, Go Teams $20/member/month), the usage-window rule and every other model row are unchanged; the only other difference against the 2026-10-30 capture is the wording 'Web Search' → 'Web search'. No leaderboard/score data, no Command Code GOAT change, no shared-pool change, no adopted.csv row, no computed allowance in this file.
adoptionStatus: research-only; not adopted; the opencode_go × deepseek-v4.1-flash adopted row is generated from scripts/build_adopted.py OPENCODE_GO_MODELS (still $80); updating it to the new $100 monthly limit is left to maintainer review

observed.promoEndMarkerNote: The official docs page and the landing page carry no promo end date and no 'limited time' marker for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. The only 'limited time' wording on the docs page belongs to other rows (the free limited-time models) and the only dated note is 'The 50% discount applies through November 30, 2026.' for Gemini 4 Argon; neither refers to this model. The landing page separately states 'DeepSeek: ZDR agreement is renewed monthly. The current agreement is valid through October 31, 2026.' — that is a data-retention agreement date, not a usage-promo end marker. Whether the new $100 tier is permanent or a phase of the promotion is therefore not stated on the pages themselves.
